name: @octanejs/react-map-gl
description: Octane bindings for react-map-gl, covering Mapbox GL JS and MapLibre GL JS.

scripts.test: pnpm upstream:check && vitest run --root ../.. --project react-map-gl --project react-map-gl-ssr --project react-map-gl-browser
scripts.upstream:check: node scripts/check-upstream.mjs && node scripts/check-test-disposition.mjs && node scripts/check-type-parity.mjs && pnpm parity:check
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-type-parity.mjs && tsrx-tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p upstream-typetests/tsconfig.json && tsrx-tsc --noEmit -p typetests/tsconfig.json
scripts.parity:generate: node scripts/check-type-parity.mjs --write && node scripts/runtime-inventory.mjs && node scripts/update-parity-manifest.mjs
scripts.parity:check: node scripts/check-type-parity.mjs && node scripts/runtime-inventory.mjs --check && node scripts/update-parity-manifest.mjs --check
